name: U-turn at a junction
description: A two-way street with a junction in the middle. A vehicle sent back the way it came must swing round through an arc. If it flips 180 degrees on the spot in one frame, U-turns have no turning geometry.

lab.expect: A two-way street with a junction in the middle. A vehicle sent back the way it came must swing round through an arc. If it flips 180 degrees on the spot in one frame, U-turns have no turning geometry.
